name: Pulse Chat AI
author: pulsechat

sections.description:
Pulse Chat AI integrates a powerful AI chat assistant into your WordPress site using an advanced ChatGPT 5 AI models. The plugin works immediately after installation – no API keys, no configuration required. Simply install, activate, and add the shortcode to start chatting with your visitors.

Features include customizable chat interface, floating chat bubble, usage limits, rate limiting, and full control over conversation behavior. Perfect for customer support, FAQs, and visitor engagement.

The plugin provides a seamless way to add AI-powered conversations to any page, post, or widget using a simple shortcode. With built-in security features, usage tracking, and a freemium model, it’s ideal for businesses looking to enhance user engagement.

Version 2.2 Highlights:
* NEW: Complete license validation system
* NEW: Automatic license validation and Pro features activation
* NEW: License status display with plan, expiration, and domain info

Version 2.1 Highlights:
* NEW: Conversation saving and management system (Pro feature)
* NEW: Full conversation history with export capabilities
* NEW: License activation page
* Improved admin menu organization

Version 2.0 Highlights:
* Complete redesign with modern React/TypeScript interface
* Unified branding system with light/dark themes
* Custom avatar support for Pro users
* Improved chat UI with message avatars
* Reorganized admin panel with tabbed interface
* Enhanced customization options

How it works:
The plugin uses a secure hosted API service provided by pulsechatai.com to generate responses. AI processing does NOT happen on the visitor’s device or the site owner’s servers. You don’t need to create an OpenAI account, configure API keys, or manage credentials. Everything is handled automatically by the service.

Key Features:
* Embeddable chat via shortcode [pulse_chat_ai]
* Works on any WordPress page/post/widget
* Zero configuration required – works immediately after activation
* Powered by an advanced GPT-based AI model
* No streaming – complete responses
* Simple admin configuration (optional customization)
* Rate limiting by IP for security
* Responsive, accessible UI
* Configurable conversation history
* Optional floating chat bubble for global access
* Usage limits: 40 messages/day, 100/month per site (free plan)
* Modern React-based admin interface
* Light/Dark theme support
* Custom branding options (Pro feature)
* Custom avatar for AI assistant (Pro feature)
* Conversation saving and history (Pro feature)
* Export conversations as JSON or CSV (Pro feature)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pulse-chat-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the shortcode [pulse_chat_ai] to any page or post where you want the chat to appear.

That’s it! The plugin works immediately – no API keys, no configuration needed. The chat will start working right away.

Optional Configuration:
Go to Pulse Chat AI in the WordPress admin menu to customize the chat appearance, system prompt, enable floating chat bubble, or set up quick questions. All settings are optional – the plugin works perfectly with default settings.

Pro Features (Available with Pro license):
* Access to GPT-5 Mini and GPT-5 models
* Advanced branding customization (themes, colors, avatar)
* Custom AI assistant avatar
* Full-screen chat mode
* Advanced positioning options for floating chat
* Conversation saving and history management
* Export conversations as JSON or CSV
* Filter conversations by date, page, and model
sections.faq:
How do I display the chat?

Use the shortcode:

[pulse_chat_ai]

Place it in any page, post, widget, or template (echo do_shortcode('[pulse_chat_ai]');).

Does the shortcode accept parameters?

No. All configuration is done in Settings > Pulse Chat AI.

How does the plugin work?

The plugin uses a secure hosted API service provided by pulsechatai.com to generate responses. AI processing does NOT happen on the visitor’s device or the site owner’s servers. The service uses an advanced GPT-based AI model to handle all AI processing. You don’t need to manage API keys, accounts, or credentials. Simply install, activate, and use the shortcode – the service handles everything automatically.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

No. The plugin connects to a secure hosted API service that handles all AI processing. You don’t need to create an OpenAI account, configure API keys, or provide any credentials. Just install and activate – it works immediately!

What AI model does the plugin use?

The free version uses a fast and efficient GPT-based AI model provided through the secure PulseChat AI service. The plugin connects to a secure hosted service that manages the AI processing – you don’t need to configure anything.

What is the REST endpoint?

The plugin exposes a REST endpoint at POST wp-json/pulse-chat-ai/v1/chat for programmatic access. However, most users will simply use the shortcode [pulse_chat_ai] which is much easier.

How do I enable the floating chat bubble?

Go to Pulse Chat AI in the WordPress admin menu and check “Enable Floating Chat” in the Main Settings tab. The bubble will appear on all pages. You can customize its position in the Pro settings.

What are the usage limits?

Free plan: 100 messages per month for your entire site. Basic plan: 1,000 messages per month. Pro plan: 10,000 messages per month. All visitors share these limits. Additional usage plans are available at pulsechatai.com.

Can I customize the chat appearance?

Yes! The free version includes basic customization options. Pro users can customize themes (light/dark), accent colors, upload custom avatars, and adjust positioning. Go to Pulse Chat AI > Pulse Chat Pro tab to access branding options (requires Pro license).

How do I upload a custom avatar for the AI assistant?

Custom avatars are available in the Pro version. Go to Pulse Chat AI > Pulse Chat Pro > Branding & UI and use the “Upload Avatar” button. Supported formats: PNG, SVG, JPG (max 500KB, square images recommended). If no custom avatar is set, the default robot icon will be used.
